Class CasseroleProperties.Chat

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.config.CasseroleProperties.Chat
Enclosing class:
CasseroleProperties
public static class CasseroleProperties.Chat extends Object
The Chat type holds the chat session defaults. The system prompt starts empty, so a new session has no system message until a prompt is set. maxMessages starts at 40. maxTokens, managedTokens, and headCount start at 0. escapeTimeoutMs starts at 100. maxPasteChars starts at 65536. The spinner starts at ascii, and the spinner interval starts at 100 milliseconds. Smart format starts on. The table style starts at ascii. historySize starts at 500. listPreviewChars starts at 120.
